title: Clear run_state beside waiting_on in the default-state clear path
action: set_default_state_waiting_on (state_group/store.rs:189-206) writes BOTH waiting_on and run_state:'awaiting-approval' into .bee/state.json, but clear_default_state_waiting_on (workflow_store/record.rs:482-499) only nulls waiting_on — run_state stays 'awaiting-approval' forever on the session-scoped no-workflow-record path (dashboard badge stuck). Fix: in clear_default_state_waiting_on, when clearing a live mark, also null run_state IFF its current value is 'awaiting-approval' (never touch any other value — a record-derived run_state from another path must not be clobbered). Keep the fail-open peek and raced-clear no-op structure unchanged. Extend clear_default_state_waiting_on_clears_a_live_mark (workflow_store/tests.rs:518) to assert run_state is cleared after the clear, and add an assertion that a non-awaiting-approval run_state value survives the clear untouched.

truths: After set-then-clear on the default-state path, .bee/state.json has waiting_on null AND no awaiting-approval run_state
A run_state value other than awaiting-approval is not modified by the clear

trace.outcome: clear_default_state_waiting_on nulls run_state (guarded on awaiting-approval) beside waiting_on; test asserts pair-clear and foreign-value survival
